seo_title: Alaska Scholarships for African American Students

intro: Finding financial support tailored for African American students in Alaska can be challenging, but there are currently 9 scholarships available that cater specifically to this demographic. Award sizes vary, with amounts ranging from approximately $500 to $10,000. Each scholarship has unique eligibility requirements and deadlines, so it’s important to review the details carefully to identify the best fit for your needs.
